Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Bargain trips now wait longer after the Sapphire Avenue Exchange aethernet request before asking Lifestream to run to the Market Board. The Market Board shortcut is retried for up to 90 seconds before falling back to manual Market Board selection.
